name: Gemma 4 E4B

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date; the report followed on arXiv 2026-07-02

params.note: Hub safetensors count incl. towers; text_only and active derived from config. Card: 4.5B effective, 8B with embeddings; 'effective' leaves out the per-layer embedding tables, which are lookups

tokenizer.note: report: Gemini tokenizer, split digits, byte-level encodings

stack.note: global at 0-based layers 5, 11, ... 41; the last layer is global. Global layers: head 512, 2 KV heads

steps.label: local: window 512, head 256, theta 10k / global: full, head 512, p-RoPE 0.25, theta 1M
RMSNorm on q and k per head (v gets a scale-free RMSNorm); scores not divided by sqrt(head_dim)
gate 2560 -> 256, GELU, times this layer's 256-wide token embedding, project back, RMSNorm
layer output times a stored scalar

specials.name: partial_rope
specials.what: p-RoPE: only 25% of each global head's dims rotate (theta 1M); local layers use full RoPE (theta 10k)

specials.name: tied_embeddings
specials.what: output head reuses the embedding table

specials.name: layer_scalar
specials.what: each layer's output is multiplied by a stored scalar

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: a separate autoregressive drafter head for speculative decoding, fed the main model's activations and KV cache
specials.where: released beside the model; not in this repo

specials.name: per_layer_embeddings
specials.what: a 262,144 x (42 x 256) table gives every layer its own small token vector, mixed in after the FFN

specials.name: kv_sharing
specials.what: last 18 layers (24-41) reuse the KV of layer 22 (local) or 23 (global)

omitted_towers.what: ViT, patch 16, axial 2D RoPE plus 2D absolute positions, variable aspect ratio
USM-based Conformer: two downsampling convs then 12 Conformer layers, 40 ms chunks

paper.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
paper.note: section 2, Table 1 (parameter counts), section 2.1-2.2 (encoders), Figure 1 (MTP drafter)

readme.note: property table: parameters, layers, sliding window, context, encoder sizes; hybrid attention, last layer global

code.note: Gemma4TextDecoderLayer: input norm, attn, post-attn norm, add, pre-ffw norm, MLP, post-ffw norm, add, [per-layer input gate, GELU, x PLE, projection, norm, add], x layer_scalar; attention scaling 1.0 with q/k RMSNorm and scale-free v norm

cfgcode.note: configuration_gemma4.py: per_layer_config sets global head_dim 512 and global KV heads when attention_k_eq_v; kv_sharing_modes

hfapi.note: license apache-2.0, license_link gemma_4_license, safetensors total 7,996,156,490

count.note: Vd (tied) + per layer q/o d*H*hd, k (and v unless k_eq_v) d*KV*hd on non-shared layers, q/k norms, GeGLU 3*d*f, 4 norms, scalar, PLE gate and projection 2*d*256 + norm + final norm; plus PLE table 262144*42*256, model projection d*42*256 and its norm

notes: Report: values = keys on global layers 'except in E2B and E4B'; config attention_k_eq_v agrees.
Report Table 1 (E4B): audio 305M, vision 150M, embedder 670M + 2,820M per-layer, einsums 3,940M; derived text parts 671M + 2,846M + 3,946M (the PLE figure here adds the 27.5M model projection).
Gallery calls it '35 sliding-window + 7 global' and 128K context; config agrees.

local.kv_source: layers 24-41 reuse the KV of layer 22

global.kv_source: layers 24-41 reuse the KV of layer 23
